children: Dutch Prime Minister Rob Jetten spoke with US President Donald Trump about preventing equipment maker ASML
from being hit by new export restrictions, Bloomberg News reported on Thursday.
Jetten had conversations with Trump about the MATCH act, and the "importance to protect the semicon industry,” the report said, citing an interview with Jetten.
"I’m pretty confident we will come to some agreement that is workable for each and every one," Jetten told Bloomberg TV.
